baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic fantasy conservation-documentation photograph of an original adult fictional woman whose visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. She kneels at the edge of a complete closed magic circle inlaid directly into wet marble inside a shallowly flooded museum gallery. Water inside the circle is still and softly luminous while water outside carries ordinary ripples; the change stops precisely at the closed line, where damp dust and a narrow scorch trace remain. Beside her, one complete articulated suit of living armor independently lifts a fallen gilded frame from the water. Show plausible shoulder, elbow, hip, and knee plate overlap, an open visor and neck gap revealing an unmistakably empty hollow interior, and grounded metal feet producing contact shadows and concentric ripples. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Use a medium-wide diagonal composition that keeps the entire circle, both water regions, her stabilizing hand, the full armor shell, empty interior, and lifted frame legible together.
